description.value: Cor's 2 For 1 Pizza has been serving gourmet pizza in Aldergrove since 1988, making it the longest-established pizza takeout in the area. The kitchen makes all doughs fresh daily from scratch and produces house-made pizza sauce and gourmet meat sauce in-house. Cyclists passing through on Fraser Highway can order pizzas, pastas, wings, and sides for pickup, or arrange catering for larger groups.

address.value: 27256 Fraser Highway, Unit 103, Aldergrove, BC V4W 3P8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, phone (604-857-2626), and address (103-27256 Fraser Hwy, Aldergrove, BC) matching OSM tags.
